verdict: M1 EVIDENCE CONTRACT PROPOSAL READY FOR RESEARCH REVIEW
formal_relationship: M1 evidence = M0 historical-safe evidence + FinMultiTime Evidence Packet

statuses.AVAILABLE: PIT-safe evidence selected under the fixed rule
statuses.UNAVAILABLE: source absent or no eligible evidence in the fixed window
statuses.AMBIGUOUS_REJECTED: observed but excluded because date/time availability cannot be proven

TEXT.pit_rule: Date < decision_session_date; same-day date-only records are AMBIGUOUS_REJECTED
deduplication: duplicate exact URL after exact-record pass
retain removed-record hashes and kept-record hash in provenance
TEXT.selection_order: newest eligible Date descending, then Url, Article_title, record hash
TEXT.representation: date, title, URL, bounded article text, record hash; no LLM semantic deduplication
TEXT.missingness: JPM is UNAVAILABLE; AAPL/AMZN with no record in [decision-30d, decision) are UNAVAILABLE

TABLE.pit_rule: filed_date < decision_session_date; period_end is never availability
TABLE.restatement_rule: for each exact taxonomy/concept/unit/start/end economic fact, select latest eligible filed version; retain accn/filed/form/member
TABLE.selection_rule: select latest eligible version for each exact period, then latest economic period by end, start, filed, accession, form
TABLE.representation: one bounded fact per selected concept with value, unit, period, filed, accession, form, provenance hash
TABLE.missingness: field-level UNAVAILABLE if no eligible fact; never substitute a later value or another symbol

TIME_SERIES.pit_rule: completed session rows with session <= decision_session
TIME_SERIES.price_semantics: declared unresolved source policy; comparison indicates partially adjusted/inconsistent behavior across target symbols
TIME_SERIES.representation: fixed numeric summary plus through_session and source hash; no target/forward labels
TIME_SERIES.missingness: UNAVAILABLE if required completed history is absent; invalid raw rows are never repaired

IMAGE.window_rule: infer H1 end=June 30 and H2 end=December 31; require inferred period_end < decision_session
IMAGE.staleness_rule: no additional fixed maximum threshold proposed; report threshold coverage for review
IMAGE.selection_rule: one latest eligible image by inferred period_end, filename, path
IMAGE.caption_rule: if later approved, image -> frozen Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct -> bounded structured caption; no Qwen in this task
IMAGE.missingness: AAPL remains UNAVAILABLE; no eligible completed image is UNAVAILABLE

budget.unit: UTF-8 characters, deterministic proxy because no tokenizer dependency is added

truncation.text: max 8 records; fixed newest-first ordering; title <=200 chars; body <=900 chars
truncation.table: max 6 concepts; fixed concept order; no unselected observations
truncation.image: at most one caption; caption bounded to 1200 chars before section envelope

availability_fields.IMAGE: inferred half-year window end, not a publication timestamp

review_questions: Accept the unresolved/partially adjusted FinMultiTime price semantics declaration?
Accept the sparse but PIT-safe fixed 30-calendar-day text lookback?
Accept the six-concept table schema and deterministic latest-eligible restatement rule?
Accept no additional image staleness threshold, subject to explicit unavailable status?
If images are retained, approve the later offline Qwen caption architecture after contract freeze?
